experiment_data.hypothesis: Joint multi-domain training (CoNLL+SciERC+FewNERD LODO) improves entity verifier AUC and cross-domain construction F1 by exposing the model to diverse entity patterns. Tests whether training data diversity overcomes the calibration gap that caused B2 original to fail on FewNERD.

metrics.verdict: AUC improved but F1 still negative. Cross-domain calibration gap unsolved.
